# snkisk

A portfolio of web and game projects. The public site showcases these projects.

- [Portfolio](https://snkisk.com/)
- [Conditional URL shortener](https://go.snkisk.com/)
- [Legitils](https://legitils.snkisk.com/)
- [Minecraft Fan Site](https://mc.snkisk.com/)
- [偏食メイト](https://hensyoku-mate.snkisk.com/)

This guide helps retrieve public information. It does not grant additional permission for model training.
